text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo says Morocco contributes to stability in the Mediterranean.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says electoral code will consolidate state of law.
- Morocco and Gabon to cooperate on devolution through exchange of experience between both countries.
- Driss Benhima, director of state-owned utility Office National de l'Electricite (ONE), says enterprise is ready to lower bills for businesses if the state maintains present taxation.
- Agriculture sector weakened by uncertain weather and non-coordinated policy.
- Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo says after meeting with King Hassan that "the European Union attaches particular importance to the points of view and analysis of Morocco".
- Saudi King Fahd pays homage to King Hassan's role as head of Al-Qods committee.
- World Food Programme decides to overlook scandal of education ministry officials charged with trading in food donations and allocates $16 million to school meals.
